cards.title: Polynomial expansion under uniform physical-noise amplification

source_refs.value: Results, polynomial form immediately before Fig. 1

cards.role: Shows that an FTQC observable remains a polynomial in a common physical-error scale even with measurements, feedback, post-selection, and decoding.

checks.reason: Supplementary Eqs. (12)--(18) expand every operation into ideal and erroneous components and group terms by error count.
Uniform replacement p_j -> r p_j multiplies every k-error product by exactly r^k.
At r=0 only the ideal map remains.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate the independently specified noise model at explicit scale factors r; do not fit or sample source-figure pixels.

cards.title: Distance-aware polynomial extrapolation
cards.latex: m=\lceil d/2\rceil,\quad V_{i0}=1,\quad V_{ij}=r_i^{m+j-1}\ (j>0),\quad b_k=(V^{-1})_{0k},\quad \langle O\rangle_{\mathrm{em}}=\sum_{k=0}^{K}b_k\langle O\rangle(r_k)
cards.role: Cancels the first K surviving logical-error powers, beginning at the code-corrected order m.

checks.reason: The basis and Vandermonde-like matrix are stated in the Methods.
The computed weights satisfy sum b_i=1 and sum b_i r_i^(m+j)=0 for j=0,...,K-1.
For two points the result cancels a pure r^m correction exactly.

cards.numerical_form: Build V from the declared r values and solve V.T * b = e0; never use an image-derived fit.

cards.title: Bias and optimally allocated sampling overhead
cards.latex: \delta=|\langle O\rangle_{\mathrm{em}}-\langle O\rangle_{\mathrm{ideal}}|,\quad N_k=\frac{|b_k|}{B}N_{\mathrm{tot}},\quad \eta=\frac{B\sum_k|b_k|[1-\langle O\rangle(r_k)^2]}{1-\langle O\rangle(r_0)^2},\quad B=\sum_k|b_k|
cards.role: Separates accuracy improvement from the sampling cost for a Pauli observable.

checks.reason: Bias, variance ratio, Pauli shot variance, and importance allocation are stated in the main Methods.
Substitution of N_k=Ntot|b_k|/B into sum b_k^2(1-O_k^2)/N_k yields the displayed dimensionless ratio.
With K=0, b_0=1 and eta=1.

cards.numerical_form: Use analytic expectation values O(r_k), the same total-shot convention, and return infinity only when the raw Pauli variance is exactly zero.

cards.title: Exact feedback and post-selection response of Main Fig. 2

source_refs.value: Main Fig. 2 and the feedback parity-check experiment

cards.role: Gives the injection-only numerical curves without reading the paper plot or author arrays.

checks.reason: The paper states independent I/X/Y/Z insertion, Q3 post-selection, and Q1-controlled feedback.
A 64-pattern Pauli enumeration agrees with the closed form for every tested r and theta.
At p=0 both raw and corrected values equal cos(theta_0), with unit acceptance.

cards.numerical_form: For each data qubit X/Y contributes a classical Z-basis flip with probability q. Q3 accepts e2=e4; Q1 feedback leaves residual flip e2.
open_questions: The dashed paper simulation also includes a non-disclosed per-gate calibration map; the exact card covers the stated injection model.

cards.title: Repetition-code logical failure and multi-round composition
cards.role: Provides a closed-form, independently checkable model of the distance and round scaling emphasized by the paper.

checks.reason: The paper states d data qubits, correction of up to ceil(d/2)-1 flips, and M+1 injected-error layers.
Correctable and failing binomial sectors sum to one.
The small-q leading logical term has order q^ceil(d/2), matching the paper's extrapolation basis.
Independent logical flips across M+1 layers multiply the logical-Z attenuation factors.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate the binomial tail with integer arithmetic/scipy-free summation; optionally compose disclosed median gate/readout flips as a separate, labelled calibration model.
open_questions: The exact gate-by-gate Processor-I calibration map used for the paper's dashed curves is not public in the article.

cards.title: Exact distance-3 rotated-surface-code Pauli channel

source_refs.value: Main Fig. 4 and logical operators XL=X_D1 X_D4 X_D7, ZL=Z_D3 Z_D4 Z_D5
Supplementary Fig. 6 and Note 4 numerical-simulation paragraph

cards.role: Enumerates all 4^9 physical Pauli errors, applies an independently reconstructed minimum-weight CSS decoder, and returns the logical I/X/Y/Z channel.

checks.reason: The paper gives the 3x3 data layout, eight syndrome qubits, logical operators, depolarizing preparation model, and calibrated p_prep=0.075.
All reconstructed X/Z stabilizers commute; both logical operators commute with the stabilizer group and anticommute with each other.
Exhaustive search finds no weight-1 logical operator and finds weight-3 logical representatives.
The four logical-channel probabilities sum to one for every evaluated p.

cards.numerical_form: Pre-enumerate each Pauli pattern's weight and decoded logical class, then evaluate its probability polynomial for each effective depolarizing rate.
open_questions: The surface-code unit injection rate is not stated; the generated plot discloses its cross-experiment assumption.

cards.title: Bravyi--Vargo logical-memory fit used by Supplementary Fig. 9

source_refs.value: Bravyi and Vargo, Phys. Rev. A 88, 062308 (2013), Eqs. (2)--(3), Table I

cards.role: Reproduces the paper's large-scale surface-code memory estimate and its distance-aware ZNE calculation.

checks.reason: The target supplement specifies p, d, amplification factors, N, and O(r); the primary reference specifies the noisy-syndrome path coefficients.
At p=1e-3 and d=11 the path-like fit gives 2.03375e-10, reproducing the main-text approximately 2e-10 anchor.
At N=0 or P_L=0 the observable is one and the raw bias vanishes.

cards.numerical_form: Use noisy-syndrome path coefficients x=(9.88,1170,-76400), c=7.52, y=(880,4690,6.04e6); use r_d=(d+1)/4 for d=7,11,15.
